title: stand up the Sample Ledger C4 map
mainwork: Read the two global requirement files and lay down the C4 map they imply: a project node at the code root, the system boundary beneath it, and a marker for each container and component, every one declaring its own testgroup and test_dir. Write the two interface contracts the parts hand data across, and the two use-cases a person actually walks.
output:
[prework] (none)
[mainwork] SEED FIXTURE — this item ships with the sample to give the archive and the run-history UI something to show; no agent ran it.
Laid down 7 C4 objects across all four levels: Sample Ledger (project), Ledger System (context), Ledger CLI and Report Renderer (container), Command Parser, Entry Store and CSV Exporter (component). Wrote interfaces/ledger-command (request-reply, served by the Command Parser) and interfaces/entry-recorded (event, served by the Entry Store), and the use-cases "Record a movement" and "Review the month".
Two nodes deliberately carry no testgroup: key — the project and context nodes are grouping only and own no code. The CSV Exporter carries test_loop: omit, because BR-5's real claim needs a spreadsheet to check and TR-1 forbids installing one; its testgroup file says so rather than shipping tests that would look like coverage without being it.
Created no follow-on work items.
[postwork] (none)
